question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: The practice involves abstention from food by day
This practice affects age and death
inference: By abstaining from food by day, one will go beyond death by aging
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo mṛtyuṃ is ambiguous; it may mean overcoming or reaching a state beyond age-related death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
